Chapter 595 - 595 Singing; Making A Move!

Chapter 595 - 595 Singing; Making a Move!

595 Singing; Making a Move!

For the next few days, Lin Fan continued to walk and look at the scenery. At night, he ate meat and slept. His days were very relaxed.

This kind of life even made the originally thin Sam’s face gradually round in the wilderness of the Otherworld. It was really different.

…

There were more than ten chosen ones in Nashland, and Augustus was one of them.

Augustus was a veteran outdoor explorer.

After many people entered the Otherworld, they would start to starve after they finished their food.

However, Augustus used his extraordinary outdoor exploration ability to lead a comfortable life.

Not long ago, when he encountered a level-two Armored Rhinoceros, he even made use of the terrain…It was cleverly killed, which increased the air quality in Nashland by 10%.

As for himself, he received 20 points of Constitution.

Augustus felt a little smug.

Augustus believed that he was chosen because of God’s approval.

Today, Augustus was as usual. After he woke up, he continued to move forward into the unknown.

As he walked forward, he kept making introductions and sighing from time to time.

“Look… This tree is simply too thick and too long! If it was on Earth, this kind of tree would probably only be seen in the Amazon forest. However, it can be seen everywhere here! This is unbelievable!

“What did I just see? This flower is so big, huh? It’s very fragrant and even has a hint of sweetness.”

…

Augustus knew that his life in the Otherworld would be broadcasted live on Earth.

This was a good opportunity to show off.

He might even gain countless fans.

As a veteran outdoor explorer, he knew very well that fans represented endless benefits.

…

Augustus’s prediction was not wrong.

With his explanation and his wonderful performance in the Otherworld, he seemed to be marching toward being the most popular hero in Nashland.

Every day, countless people would come to watch his live broadcast.

At this moment, Nashland was broadcasting live.

The tall and thin host held the microphone and said excitedly, “Look! Our hero Augustus has begun his adventure again. Let’s see what he’ll encounter in the Other world today.]

Jani: [Augustus is still so powerful!]

Kukenvito: [Others treat the Otherworld as hell, but our Augustus is like an amusement park!]

TN: [Augustus is a true hero and Earth’s greatest hope!]

SSSSSS: [Augustus, charge!]

FFFF: [Not only is he powerful, but he’s also very gentle… Augustus, I love you!]

…

Just as Augustus was silently introducing, a dull voice suddenly sounded in the distance.

In the next moment…

A three-meter-tall rhinoceros with sharp horns slowly poked its head out from the forest in the distance.

A cold light flickered in the rhinoceros’ eyes, and it emitted a terrifying aura.

If it was an ordinary Earthling, they would have been so scared that their legs would have gone weak and they would have turned around and fled without hesitation.

However, Augustus’ eyes lit up.

He was not afraid and said, “Look, what did I see?” Another rhinoceros monster!

“Last time, because the cliff was too high, I couldn’t eat meat. This time, my physique has increased, so there shouldn’t be any problems!

“The size of this rhinoceros monster is probably enough for me to eat for a month… I’ll tell everyone how it tastes after I taste it.”

The rhinoceros seemed to have been provoked by Augustus’ words and roared at the sky.

Then, it exerted strength in its four limbs and rushed toward him.

Fierce!

It looked like a speeding truck, extremely terrifying.

Augustus’ heart skipped a beat.

Obviously, he did not expect the rhinoceros to have such speed.

However, after using 20 points of Constitution, his speed and strength had been greatly improved.

It was not a problem for him to dodge the impact.

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

“What did we just see?” the lanky host asked excitedly. “Augustus has encountered another rhinoceros monster! Haha! Let’s look forward to his exciting performance!”

JJ: [Great, Augustus has finally encountered another monster!]

Ken Rene: [I still remember the battle between Augustus and the Armored Rhinoceros clearly. It was so exciting!]

MMM: [Augustus, you can do it!]

Home: [This rhino is unlucky to have met Augustus.]

H: [Go, go, go!]

…

Augustus was indeed charging forward.

The speed of the rhinoceros was beyond his imagination, and it almost hit him several times.

Gradually, Augustus’ forehead was covered in sweat.

…

At this moment, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam were still strolling in the wilderness.

“Master, are you bored?” Sam asked. “Why don’t I sing a song for you to relieve your boredom?”

“You can sing?” Lin Fan was surprised.

“Yes!” Sam said seriously. “My singing teacher said that I have a talent for singing. Oh right, I can also sing Hua songs.”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Alright, then you can sing.”

Sam happily said, “Okay!”

“Two lions, two lions, running fast, running fast, one has no eyes, one has no tail, how strange, how strange…”

This was originally a lively children’s song, but he used a very bold voice.

At the same time, he was extremely serious and iron-blooded.

It was as if he was singing a battle song on the battlefield, and it looked very out of place.

“Master, how was my singing?” Sam asked.

As he spoke, he fixed his gaze on Lin Fan. His eyes were filled with anticipation.

Lin Fan looked at him and said, “You sang very well. Don’t sing again in the future.”

“Huh?” Sam was stunned.

He was about to ask.

Why did he tell him not to sing anymore if he sang well?

At this moment, a loud sound came from afar, attracting their attention.

In the next moment…

A huge horned rhinoceros appeared in their field of vision.

In front of the rhinoceros was a white-skinned man who was constantly fleeing.

It was Augustus!

“Master, there’s someone being chased by a rhinoceros over there. It’s about to catch up!” Sam hurriedly said.

In fact, even without Sam saying anything, Lin Fan had already noticed it.

Moreover, he could also calculate that according to that man’s current state, in one minute…

Augustus was about to be sent flying by the rhinoceros.

At this moment, Augustus accidentally kicked a rock, and his entire body seemed to be on the verge of falling down.

The rhino seized the opportunity and charged at him.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan pulled out his sword.

[Sword 1: Draw the sword and slash the heavens!]

With a flash of light, the head of the rhinoceros fell heavily to the ground like a huge rock, making a muffled sound.

Fresh blood spurted out!
